title: Vorssaint: free SoundSource alternative
caption:
SoundSource charges $49. Vorssaint does per-app volume for free 🎚

✅ Volume mixer: set each app's volume, boost past 100%
✅ System monitor: CPU, GPU, memory and temperatures
✅ Window snapping, app switcher and clipboard history
✅ No account, no tracking, no subscription

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Apple Silicon only, macOS 14+

Comment "MENU" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
